summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by West Fraser Timber Co., Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, to announce a news release regarding the notice of its second quarter 2026 results conference call. The call is scheduled for July 30, 2026, to discuss financial and operating results. There are no special-situation transactions such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic reviews. The filing is a standard earnings announcement and conference call notice with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. As a routine current report, it does not constitute a special situation. The non-US filing is mapped to its equivalent SEC reporting requirement for foreign issuers.
